SIKA® AIR: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® AIR, April 2023, Version 01.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/5/sika_air.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® AIR where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.03).
1.2 Product description. Sika® AIR is an air-entraining agent based on synthetic surfactants. Its efficiency is based upon the entrainment into the mix of a high number of correctly sized and evenly distributed air bubbles.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Sika® Air is used to.
    - improve resistance to freeze-thaw action in hardened concrete;
    - increase cohesion, reducing the concrete’s tendency to bleed in the plastic state;
    - improve compaction of low workability mixes including semi-dry concrete.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® AIR
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: AEA – Air Entraining Agent
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates. Sika® AIR meets and exceeds all requirements of Australian Standard 1478.1-2000 for Air-entraining Admixture (AEA).
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Increased freeze-thaw resistance.
    - Reduced bleed water.
    - Improves concrete workability.
    - Increases cohesion and reduces the risk of segregation.
    - No effects on setting time.
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Clear orange-brown liquid
    - Specific gravity: 1.01 g/cm³
2.5 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 205 litre drum; Bulk deliveries
    - Shelf life: Stored at temperatures between 5°C and 35°C in unopened original containers protected from direct sunlight and frost, shelf life is at least one (1) year.
    - Storage conditions: Store at temperature between 5°C and 35°C ,protected from direct sunlight .

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.03) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.03) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Dispensing: Sika® AIR is added directly to the mixing water.
4.3 Recommended dosage. Typical dose rate for general concrete production ranges within 50-150 ml per cubic meter of concrete. For low slump concrete (<65 mm slump) and pavement type concrete, specific concrete that contain high volumes of fly ash, substantially higher dose rates of Sika Air may be required to achieve the desired air content. Typical dose rates for high volume fly ash or low slump concrete range from 100-600 ml per cubic metre of concrete. Optimum dosage depends on the type of concrete, site conditions, mix proportions and desired plastic and hardened concrete properties. Laboratory and/or field trials are essential in determining the optimum dosage. Factors affecting air content include sand, cement, fly ash, aggregates and combinations with other admixtures.
4.4 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Exact dosage rates of Sika® AIR can be determined by air meter test in trial mixes.
    - High air content will most likely have a detrimental effect on strengths.
    - For additional information, please contact your local Sika Representative.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.03) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Exact dosage rates of Sika® AIR can be determined by air meter test in trial mixes.
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® AIR, April 2023, Version 01.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/5/sika_air.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika® AIR, version 15/06/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/y/sds-sika-air.pdf
    - Environmental Product Declaration: EPD Sika® AIR, version 12/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/h/epd-sika-air.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users should refer to the most recent Material Safety Data Sheet containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
